t: 3438 – Find Valid Pair of Adjacent Digits in String
o: Scan the string left to right; for each adjacent differing pair, check whether each digit's total count in s equals its numeric value. Length ≤ 100 makes anything work. Examples: "2523533" → '2' occurs 2×, '3' occurs 3×, first valid pair "23"; "22" has no differing adjacent digits → "".
k: One pass with a frequency table suffices.
Only differing adjacent digits need checking.

a.i: Precompute digit frequencies, then test each adjacent pair in order; return the first passing pair.
s: For each i, if s[i]≠s[i+1] and count matches both values, return the pair.
a.t: O(n) — one counting pass plus one scan.

w: Trivial; the only pitfall is forgetting the a≠b requirement (see "22"). No meaningful follow-ups.
